name: BROWS AND MORE SALON
address: Flat #401, Al Zarooni - Al Rigga Rd - above Westzone Supermarket - Al Muraqqabat - Deira - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Brows and More Salon is one of the foremost and trendiest salons based in Dubai. We provide a full range of personal care services to every fashion and beauty enthusiast. You can choose from premium lash extensions, microblading and skin treatments at competitive prices.

Modern and advanced beauty treatments at the salon ensure clients are pampered and look their best at all times. Our highly-trained and professional team of experts offer microblading, lash extensions, radiant skin, stunning nail art, and much more. Our salon features a luxurious, upscale ambiance as well as the best beauty products, services, and amenities.

reviews.author: Corazon Intino Haddad (Mimi)
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Brows and More Salon! Anita was absolutely amazing—very professional, friendly, and attentive. I especially loved the pedicure, massage, and eyebrow threading. She did such a great job and made me feel so relaxed and pampered.

Highly recommend Anita and Brows and More Salon! I’ll definitely be coming back. ❤️

reviews.author: alyssa k
reviews.text:
I went to this salon on Thursday to get my hair dyed black specifically to cover the lighter sections in my hair. Black is one of the most straightforward colors to achieve, yet only three days later and before I’ve even washed my hair once, you can already see lighter patches showing through.When I contacted the salon, instead of taking responsibility, they insisted the color looked black when I left and suggested that I “must have done something” to my hair, despite me telling them I hadn’t even shampooed it yet.They also claimed it couldn’t be their product or technician because it looked fine after the blow dry.I requested a full refund because I no longer trust the product used on my hair. Instead, they refused to refund me and only offered a touch up with a different technician. My issue isn’t just the technician, it’s that the color didn’t last even until my first wash, and I don’t want the same product used on my hair again.
I expected much better customer service. Rather than acknowledging my concerns, they blamed me and refused to take accountability. Unfortunately, I can’t recommend this salon based on my experience.

reviews.author: Sayani Mondal
reviews.text:
Excellent Experience with Mary at Brows & More Salon, Al Rigga!

I recently got my haircut and blow-dry done by Mary, and I honestly couldn’t be happier! She is an absolute gem — professional, friendly, and incredibly talented. At first, I was a bit skeptical about getting a haircut in Dubai, but Mary completely changed my perception.

As a senior hairdresser and head stylist, she truly knows what suits your face and personality. She gives honest suggestions and ensures you walk out feeling confident and beautiful. Her skills and precision are outstanding, but what makes her special is her caring and compassionate nature. She makes every client feel valued and comfortable — no wonder everyone asks for her by name!

I’ve developed such a great bond with her, and honestly, I visit the salon only because of Mary. She’s polite, polished, and always goes the extra mile to make sure you’re happy with the result.

To the management: Please recognize her amazing work — she truly deserves a raise! Talented professionals like Mary are the reason clients keep coming back.

Highly recommend her to anyone looking for the best hair experience in Dubai! 💇‍♀️✨

reviews.author: Pearly Shell's
reviews.text:
I’m writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service I received from the receptionist during my recent visit to Brows and More. This was my second time coming to your salon, and unfortunately, both times I encountered the same rude and unprofessional behavior from the receptionist.
While I have no complaints about the services provided by Sunny, who did my sister’s microshading and whom we were both very satisfied with, I found the receptionist’s attitude to be consistently unwelcoming and discourteous. The behavior was not only off-putting but also left a negative impression on my experience at your otherwise excellent salon.
I believe it’s important to bring this matter to your attention so that you can address it with your team. I would appreciate it if future visits could be handled with more respect and professionalism from the front desk staff.

reviews.author: Joanna Marie Villanueva
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely terrible experience at this salon. I got my eyebrows microbladed last January, and from the very beginning, they were uneven. I asked them to fix it, and they told me it could only be done after my eyebrows healed. They promised me a “special technology” would correct it by February.

I waited an entire month for the fix. I even had to cut my bangs to hide my failed eyebrows, feeling self-conscious every day. I was so excited to finally get it corrected… but when I went back, it was another disappointment. My eyebrows ended up thicker than before and still completely uneven.

I feel so frustrated, hurt, and honestly traumatized by this experience. I just wanted eyebrows I could feel confident in, and instead, I’ve been left stressed and disappointed for months.
